comparisons.locator: Physical pp.12-13, Table II and Fig.6, section5.4 first paragraph
comparisons.question: Joint observation/transmission versus separately optimized resources using JOTSAS

reported_or_visually_confirmed.weighted_completion_reward: joint above separate at all four plotted points; both nearly flat from8 to9hours

comparisons.conditions: 3 AEOS;12h horizon;default medium area and3 ground stations;listed switching times zero;error-free transmission and simplified quality inherited from model reading.
comparisons.limitations: No exact curve ordinates digitized, no improvement percentage inferred. Fig6 task count not separately explicit;100 tasks in following paragraph belongs to later comparisons and is not assigned to Fig6. Not a comparison involving orbital maneuvers.

comparisons.question: Different solvers for the same joint configuration/assignment/coverage model
comparisons.conditions: 10/20satellites,500/1000/2000candidate slots;Intel i7-9700 3GHz,32GB;Gurobi9.1.1 uses8cores;heuristic principally serial apart from LR1;0.5% solver gap tolerance.
comparisons.limitations: RP=(heuristic objective-Gurobi incumbent)/Gurobi incumbent under this paper negative-valued formulation. It is not an improvement over the mathematical optimum or proof that joint modeling beats separate modeling.

comparisons.locator: Physical pp.18-23, sectionIV.A and Table2 rows13,16,24 with footnotes
comparisons.question: Full-horizon MCRP, myopic MP, and one-stage-look-ahead RHP under their stated solving configurations
comparisons.conditions: Full comparison set24instances;3/5satellites,50/75slots,3/4/5stages;5days,100s step;known time-dependent targets;600m/s per-satellite budget;Gurobi11.0.0,Intel i9-13900,32GB,all32threads allowed;MCRP limit10800s,each MP/RHP subproblem3600s;MP/RHP table runtime cumulative.
comparisons.limitations: Selected examples illustrate differing tradeoffs, not aggregate ranking. Information and solver budgets do not establish equal-cost operational architecture comparison. Reward is sampled coverage, not completed imaging/downlink. Original paper explicitly warns against extrapolating the24instances.

comparisons.locator: Physical pp.25 and28, sectionIV.B and Fig.10
comparisons.question: Number of reconfiguration stages in a known historical Hurricane Harvey path case
comparisons.conditions: Known historical path sampled into17targets,12h per target,100s time step;MCRP solved to reported0.01% or smaller gap;no MP/RHP used for this comparison.
comparisons.limitations: This is neither the MP/RHP/MCRP solver comparison nor measured disaster response/product delivery.
